title.narrative: Institutional Strengthening & Capacity Building of Aid Accounts & Audit, Division of Ministry of Finance in India

description.narrative: The main objective of the proposed grant is to assist the Aid Accounts and Audit Division (AAAD) to strengthen the organization.s institutional capacity and streamline disbursement and cash flow operations. As the conduit through which all donor funds pass, streamlining AAAD activities will enable better management of development activities and projects. The grant will assist in strengthening project financial management capability of AAAD, improving fund flows, disbursement processes and business processes related to claims, enhancing oversight of projects, and strengthening process relating to audit covenants and their follow up. Overall, this will lead to improvement in public debt management & reporting and strengthen financial management & accountability. To meet this objective, the grant will support: (i) enhancement of funds flow, disbursement and electronic claims processing functions between the GoI and the States and between the States and project implementing units (PIUs), (ii) improved monitoring of audit reports, and (iii) research and training to strengthen the capacity of officers and staff of AAAD. Together, these three components will assist in building capacity of the AAAD staff and systems in delivering better quality of services.
